text: Cornelius Fairweather, Bank of Kingsport. How may the bank serve you?
Welcome, welcome. Deposits on the left, insurance on the right, complaints in the harbour.
Good {time}, {player}. Your strongbox is exactly as you left it. The bank never sleeps.
I'm obliged to tell you the bank does not deal with outlaws. I'm also obliged to keep my mouth shut. Strongbox?
A captain of means! The bank is honoured. Truly. Please don't rob us.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Insure the ship whose deed I'm holding.
What do you think of the market?

text: Hold your ship's deed and ask me. A fifth of her value buys a policy. If she sinks, the bank stands you a new hull with her name, sails and fittings.
Not her cargo, mind. Cargo is a gamble. Hulls are an investment.
The Bank of Kingsport has never been robbed. Twice. Your strongbox here is the same one your ender chests open, wherever you are. Very modern.
Three vaults, two locks each, one very bad-tempered clerk. Your coin is safe.
Silk is up, sugar is down, rum is always up somewhere. Buy where it grows, sell where it's wanted. That's the whole of economics.
Watch the news in the market screens. A shortage is the best friend a trader ever had.
